verdict.rationale: HubSpot's API docs confirm CRUD endpoints, batch retrieval, upserts via contact/custom object endpoints, and webhooks for real-time change events, supporting bidirectional sync capability. However, the evidence pack lacks any documented rate limits, explicit upsert semantics, or scale guarantees, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec, so key parts of the story (documented rate limits, formalized upsert/change-detection API contracts) are unconfirmed.
